turns.prompt_text: what is the diameter of a standard Ragu jar
turns.response_html: The diameter of a standard 24-ounce Ragu pasta sauce jar is approximately 3.3 inches (84 mm). The lid for this size typically uses an 82 mm continuous thread finish.

turns.prompt_text: is that an inner diameter or outer diameter
turns.response_html: The outer diameter of the glass body is approximately 3.3 inches. The 82 mm measurement refers to the outer diameter of the jar's threads, which matches the internal diameter of the lid.

turns.prompt_text: What is the internal diameter of the lid in inches?
turns.response_html:
The internal diameter of an 82 mm lid is approximately 3.23 inches.

To be more precise regarding how these fit, here is a breakdown of the measurements:

  • Metric: $82 \text{ mm} \div 25.4 \text{ mm/inch} \approx 3.228 \text{ inches}$.
  • Tolerance: Because the lid must clear the glass threads, the actual clear space inside the lid is usually exactly 3.23 inches, while the outer diameter of the glass threads on the jar is slightly smaller (around 3.18 to 3.21 inches) to ensure a smooth fit.

Note: If you are measuring for a 3D printing project or a custom mechanical fit, it is often helpful to account for the pitch of the threads. Standard Ragu jars typically use a "deep" or "regular" continuous thread (CT) style rather than a lug (twist) finish.
